notes.title: Morbid Metal Made Waves at Gamescom 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Last week at Gamescom 2025, Morbid Metal had its biggest showing yet! With press from all over the world checking out the game, the response was incredible.[/p][p]We couldn’t be more grateful for the amazing feedback. Here are just a few highlights:[/p][p]💬 [b][url="https://www.gamestar.de/artikel/morbid-metal-preview-geheimtipp,3438378.html"]GameStar[/url]:[/b] [i]“Morbid Metal is at the top of my wish list.”[/i][/p][p]💬 [b][url="https://arkaden.dk/features/arkaden-interview-fra-sovevaerelse-til-ubisoft-felix-schades-rejse-med-morbid-metal/"]Arkaden[/url] [/b](interview with Felix Schade)[b]:[/b] [i]“In eight years he has built one of the most promising action games from a small bedroom to a project backed by Ubisoft.”[/i][/p][p]💬 [b][url="https://www.eurogamer.de/morbid-metal-hat-devil-may-cry-flair-nur-dass-ich-samurai-androids-echt-cool-finde"]Eurogamer Germany[/url]:[/b] [i]“In the old demo, I often felt like I was losing track of the enemies' attacks. In the new demo, however, I was always able to dodge and counterattack very well, which isn't usually my favorite skill in games, but here it became my favorite tactic.”[/i][/p][p]💬 [b][url="https://tweakers.net/reviews/13676/morbid-metal-snelle-roguelite-met-fijne-flow.html"]Tweakers[/url]:[/b] [i]“This is one of the more beautiful Unity games I’ve ever seen.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/edb80f01d94913671968f994725399c5b3755aac.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]What’s Next[/h3][p]We’re heading full speed toward [b]Early Access on Steam this fall[/b] and your feedback is shaping every step.[/p][p]Thank you for all the love and support at Gamescom. We can’t wait to show you more, and most importantly, to see the incredible combos you’ll pull off once you get your hands on the game.
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]💥 Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Launch Delayed – Thank You for Your Support!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]We wanted to let you know that the Early Access launch of Morbid Metal is being delayed to [b]fall 2025.[/b] [/p][p]The response to the demo has been incredible. Thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and supported the game. It’s been really encouraging, and your input has given us a lot to think about. If you haven’t got the chance to try it, it’s still available and not going anywhere for now! [/p][p]To make sure we do justice to that feedback and deliver the best experience possible, we’ve decided to take a bit more time before launching into Early Access. This will help us refine key systems, improve performance, and ensure the game meets your expectations. [/p][p]We’ll keep you updated as development progresses. Thanks again for your patience and support - we’re excited to share more with you soon! [/p][p]The Morbid Metal Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]💥 Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Morbid Metal Hits 300,000 Wishlists – Thank You!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We just hit 300,000 wishlists on Steam.[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts: thank you. Every wishlist, comment, share, and bit of hype you’ve thrown our way keeps this project alive. Morbid Metal started as a small solo prototype, and seeing this many of you ready to dive in is honestly surreal.[/p][p]We’re working hard to make sure Early Access isn’t just [i]more of the demo[/i]—it’s going to be a huge step up. More polish, more enemies, more environments, and of course, more shapeshifting chaos. We want it to feel like a real evolution of what you’ve played so far.[/p][p]Stay tuned, stay lethal, and keep slashing that wishlist button if you haven’t yet.[/p][p]Early Access is coming—and it’s going to be worth the wait.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💥 Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Morbid Metal: Steam Next Fest Recap
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys,[/p][p]Steam Next Fest has officially wrapped, and we’re blown away by the response to the Morbid Metal demo. Your time, feedback, and support meant the world to our small team. Here’s a quick look at what went down:[/p][h3]📊 [b]Stats (because numbers are cool)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i][b]66,000+ players[/b][/i] stepped into the arena[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]26,200+ hours[/b][/i] of stylish combat logged[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]32,000+ iterations[/b][/i] of the roguelike loop conquered[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]176,000+ shapeshifts[/b][/i] executed with deadly precision[/p][/*][/list][p]From first-timers to character-action roguelike veterans, it’s been incredible seeing the variety of playstyles emerge and how quickly many of you pushed the combat to its stylish limits.[/p][h3]🧠 [b]Your Feedback[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been watching streams, reading comments, and absorbing every bug report. Here’s a quick breakdown:[/p][p][b]✅ The Good[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]Striking visuals[/b][/i] and a bold art direction that stands out[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Distinct playable characters[/b][/i], each with their own skills, combos, and combat identity[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Fluid, responsive combat[/b][/i] that feels great to control[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Strong potential[/b][/i] — players see the foundations of something truly special[/p][/*][/list][p][b]⚠️ The Not So Good[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]Performance issues[/b][/i] and room for optimization across systems[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Limited accessibility options[/b][/i], including UI scaling and text readability[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Demo length[/b][/i] felt too short to fully appreciate the depth of the game[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Sound effects and animations[/b][/i] need additional polish and impact[/p][/*][/list][p]All feedback is immensely valuable. We’re using it to prioritize fixes, polish mechanics, and sharpen the experience.[/p][hr][/hr][p]As a small, independent team, seeing Morbid Metal get this kind of spotlight is surreal. Every wishlist, stream, and Discord message is fuel for us.[/p][p]To everyone who played, posted, or even just hit “Download”—thank you. You’ve given us momentum we won’t waste.[/p][p]Now, we’re going straight back to work to deliver you an Early Access launch that won’t just be more of what you played—it’ll be bigger, better, and [i]tougher[/i].[/p][hr][/hr][p]💥 Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to The Sublime Garden
notes.notes: [p]The Sublime Garden is the first section of the Simulation you travel to once the iteration is started.[/p][p]Beautiful vistas dotted with broken ruins—this place once held a different purpose.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/bb0b87b222356e9421dd32449e760e3785a947f1.png"][/img][/p][p]This section is home to a variety of foes—from the leaping Servants, the shielded Bruisers, the airborne HA-3, to the crashing Noko.[/p][p]But it’s not all pain! Somewhere in the Sublime Garden, you’ll find a shrine that unlocks Ekku, the relentless brawler and the second playable character in your arsenal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/4fa68cfb9e8b6b449363134bf975c8fe2306753c.png"][/img][/p][p]This is just the beginning. And if this place is paradise lost… what comes next won’t be so “pretty”.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]💥[/i] Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo for Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Enemy Spotlight: Meet the Servants
notes.notes: [p]Once designed as caretakers within the Simulation, Servants are now corrupted, hostile husks—half-tech, half-organic. These enemies are among the first you’ll face, and they don’t hold back.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/527f11abf7853e635bae31eaeb8f4c7cec53a6ef.png"][/img][/p][p]The baseline model—Agile and aggressive, Servants leap toward you with deadly speed, slashing with bladed forearms forged from warped alloys and muscle-like fiber.[/p][p]Their movements are direct, but don’t get sloppy, they punish hesitation. They may be the weakest foes in the Simulation, but their off-screen leaps have humbled more players than we can count.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]💥[/i] Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo for Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Meet Ekku: The Heavy Hitter with a Heavy Heart
notes.notes: [p]Alright guys, it’s time to meet Ekku, the second playable character you can unlock in Morbid Metal.[/p][p]Before Flux showed up, Ekku was the Operator’s last, desperate shot at creating the perfect AI. Stoic, quiet, and carrying the weight of being “never enough”, Ekku keeps their emotions buried deep—until it explodes in devastating bursts of power.[/p][previewyoutube="HFpT79o4RqU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In combat, Ekku is your brawler. Big swings, big slams, big damage. When you need to clear a crowd or smash a boss’ face in, Ekku is your pick. Here is what they bring to the fight:[/p][list][*][p][b]GROUND CLEAVE [/b]— Slam the ground and stun anything in range. Satisfying![/p][/*][*][p][b]ECHO STRIKE [/b]— Two heavy swings. The second one scales off the first—hit hard, then hit harder.[/p][/*][*][p][b]SEISMIC RIFT [/b]— Charge it up, then unleash hell in a line in front of you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DODGE COUNTER[/b] — Evade and retaliate with a ground-shaking smash.[/p][/*][*][p][b]JUGGERNAUT[/b] (Passive) — Bonus damage against stunned enemies and a stubborn streak that resists stuns.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ekku is the raw force to Flux’s precision, and you’ll want both when things get ugly. Swap them in, cause chaos, and keep progressing.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]💥[/i] Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo for Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Flux: Your New Favorite Killing Machine
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, have you met Flux?[/p][p]Say hello to Flux, the Operator’s latest (and most promising) creation inside Morbid Metal’s digital hellscape. Flux isn’t just another AI trying to stay alive in the Simulation—they’re here to tear through enemies, defy expectations, (and maybe burn the whole system down while they’re at it).[/p][previewyoutube="NagbFhvwE58;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Flux is fast and absolutely lethal in single-target combat. They are your go-to for precise, high single-target damage. Flux is the Operator’s sleek, deadly vision of what AI evolution should look like, armed with a razor-sharp arsenal of skills:[/p][list][*][p][b]BLINK STRIKE[/b] — Zip to your target and hit ‘em before they know you’re there.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NANO BLADES[/b] — Hurl a barrage of deadly slashes like it’s no big deal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BLADEFORM[/b] — Big damage. Bigger executions. If the foe is weak, it’s done.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DODGE COUNTER[/b] — Evade and retaliate with a flurry of vicious cuts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HONED BLADE[/b] (Passive) — More crits, more carnage.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you carve your way through waves of corrupted machines, Flux will unlock the forms of their fallen AI siblings—letting your shapeshift mid-fight and stack up new abilities on the fly.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]💥[/i] Morbid Metal is live now as a free demo for Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Morbid Metal Demo is Live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]You have waited for so long and the Morbid Metal demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest![/p][p]Morbid Metal is a fast-paced, third-person character action roguelike set in a corrupted virtual world built to preserve humanity after climate collapse. You play as Flux, an AI capable of shapeshifting into unique fighters mid-combat. Your goal: survive deadly arenas, adapt across runs, and break free from the decaying Simulation.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s in the Demo?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]ONE BIOME: Battle your way through stunningly brutal environments in the first biome.[/p][/*][*][p]UNLOCK EKKU: Add a new playable character with his own combat style and set of skills to your roster[/p][/*][*][p]SHAPESHIFT COMBAT: Execute perfect Dodge Counters, chain stylish combos, and perform seamless transformations.[/p][/*][/list][p]The Demo ends just as the Simulation starts pushing back harder. Will you be ready for what comes next?[/p][previewyoutube="YL9ArylnvzY;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]Morbid Metal enters Early Access on August 20th — with more biomes, playable characters, systems, and lore to uncover.[/p][p]💬 Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.gg/8wqwvm3suZ"]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Morbid Metal.[/p][p]👉 Follow us on [url="https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame"]X (Twitter)[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/"]Instagram[/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame"]TikTok[/url] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Simulation![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Regarding dark/ unreadable UI in the Demo

[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]we've seen your complaints about the unreadable/ dark UI. We are very sorry for the issues this is causing, but rest assured, this will be fixed as soon as possible.[/p][p]This issue arises due to HDR being turned on in your windows settings. Felix[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Morbid Metal is launching into Early Access this summer!
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting News![/h1]

Hey everyone, we’ve got something exciting to share! Our new trailer for Morbid Metal just dropped during the Triple-I Initiative showcase, and we’re beyond hyped that the game is officially set to launch into [b]Early Access this summer[/b] exclusively on Steam.

[previewyoutube=UKiW3UmlcG8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been many years since the development of Morbid Metal started and I posted the first bits and pieces online. Now we are a small team of passionate developers working on it and we are so proud to finally be able to say it is coming this summer! 

All of you have been eagerly waiting to [i]finally[/i] get your hands on Morbid Metal to unleash your stylish combos onto deadly enemies. Your continued support means so much to us and the project would not have been possible without it. Thank you!

We'll have more news coming in the time leading up to the launch, so be sure to follow us here on Steam and our socials so you do not miss anythiung!

Love you guys,
Felix

notes.title: We're Up for the Unity Award - Help Us Bring It Home!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's Felix here, Game Director and founder of Screen Juice. And I have some [b]super exciting news[/b] to share with you today!

[b]We've just been nominated for the [b]Unity Awards 2024[/b] in the "Most Anticipated" category![/b]
VOTE NOW AT unity.com/de/awards


I can't tell you how surreal it feels to see our game get this kind of recognition after all the hard work the team and I have been putting in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/60f727585e6e3ba3a8829db5499cbe33dfe93986.png[/img]
The nomination came as part of Unite 2024 in Barcelona, which was an absolute blast. Being surrounded by so many talented developers and creative minds was beyond motivating, but seeing our project running for such a prestigious award? That was the cherry on top!

Now, this is where [b]you [/b] come in - voting is live, and we would absolutely love your support. 
If you've been following our journey or if you're excited to see Morbid Metal come to life, it would mean the world to us if you could take a moment to vote for us in the "Most Anticipated" category. Every vote counts, and with your help, we can make it all the way!

[h2]Here's how to vote:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Head over to the official Unity Awards 2024 page at unity.com/de/awards
[*] Choose your favorites for each category, and in the "[b]Most Anticipated[/b]" category, look for [b]Morbid Metal[/b]!
[*] Cast your vote and help bring us one step closer to that shiny award!
[/olist]
As always, your support and enthusiasm keep us going, and this nomination has really fired us up to push the game even further. We can't wait to show you more of what we've been working on. There are some exciting updates coming soon, so keep an eye out!

Thank you for sticking with us on this wild ride. Youre support means so much to us, and together, let's make this happen!

Also dont forget to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/SBessz57vA]Morbid Metal Discord[/url]!

Stay awesome,  
Felix & the Morbid Metal Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Stay metal,

notes.title: Happy new year, friends!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/d4fe88c8b6dfbf307b5bc4ac7cc6acb3bf9ecfee.png[/img]
It's Felix again. Hi! I'm the Game Director and (former) single dev of Morbid Metal. And I know, I know... another year has passed and still no news about Morbid Metal.

It's true that it's been quite a while since we showed bits and pieces. But that's for a good reason: we are pretty busy working on bringing our vision to life and to your screens, offering the best possible experience.

And we will show you more of it in the future (pinky promise!). So stay tuned, and please whishlist and follow Morbid Metal here on Steam since this would really help us a lot ❤️ And keep checking the Steam page every now and then, there will be more to discover soon.

Thanks for your feedback and your patience - both is wholeheartedly appreciated!

We wish you all a great start into 2024!
Felix & the Morbid Metal Team

notes.title: Big News: Introducing Screen Juice and the Exciting Future of Morbid Metal!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there, Morbid Metal fans![/h2]

Felix here, and I'm absolutely raring to share some fantastic news with you all! 

First of all, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for your constant support and unyielding passion towards Morbid Metal. It's been a while since my last update, but I assure you, this radio silence is for good reason! Get ready, because I have some news that will take Morbid Metal to unprecedented heights!

I am proud to announce that I have recently founded SCREEN JUICE, an indie studio focused on making my dream project, Morbid Metal, even larger and better than ever before! Over the past year, I've been working diligently in the shadows to build a talented team that is as passionate about this game as I am. Our team may be small, but it's packed with amazing individuals who are focused on bringing you the best possible experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41770758/1a8f437a13009e380292f5c205eaabf39f661753.png[/img]
[h3]So, what does this mean for the development of Morbid Metal you ask? [/h3]

It means that I now have the funding, the resources, and the crew to expand the scope of the project beyond what I initially envisioned. The development process is no longer that of a lone wolf, but of a collective force of creative minds that want to exceed even your wildest expectations!

I know the silence might have been disconcerting, but trust me, it was all to ensure a smoother and more focused development process. I wanted to be absolutely certain of this major step before making any announcements. Together with my team at SCREEN JUICE I am now hard at work and we are refining every aspect of Morbid Metal, breathing new life into its world, systems and characters!

It's time to break the habit of being tight-lipped and reignite the communication that you deserve. Prepare yourselves for more in-depth looks at the story, characters, and gameplay systems that make up the world of Morbid Metal!

As always, I am immensely grateful for your support during this journey. Please stay tuned for further updates, first-looks, and other cool tidbits that I can't wait to share. The future of MORBID METAL is brighter than ever!

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for believing in the vision of Morbid Metal and for joining us at SCREEN JUICE on our wild ride towards delivering an unforgettable game!

Stay metal!

- Felix
[i] Founder of SCREEN JUICE & Game Director/ Lead Developer of Morbid Metal[/i]
